public.text: Requiring a nationally governed information model may be difficult in countries with limited modelling capacity. The text does not describe how international or regional artefacts can be adopted with minimal national adaptation.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a progressive pathway: adopt suitable international or regional models first, document only necessary national constraints and extensions, and develop broader national modelling governance as capacity grows.
